extName.description: Extension name. A product name (PD-006) — never translate it.

extDescription.message: Fill every form control on a page with plausible dummy data in one action.
extDescription.description: Store listing and browser extension-list description. Must share no wording with Fake Filler (C-010).

commandFillAllInputs.message: Fill all inputs on the page
commandFillAllInputs.description: Keyboard command, shown in the browser's own shortcuts settings (UC-030).

commandFillCurrentForm.description: Keyboard command, shown in the browser's own shortcuts settings (UC-030).

commandFillSelectedInput.description: Keyboard command shipped unbound by DD-007; the user assigns it themselves.

menuFillAllInputs.description: Context menu item for the page scope (UC-001).

menuFillCurrentForm.description: Context menu item for the form scope (UC-002).

menuFillSelectedInput.description: Context menu item for the single-control scope (UC-003).

optionsPlaceholder.message: There is nothing to configure yet. Filling works from the toolbar button, the right-click menu, and the keyboard shortcuts listed in your browser's extension settings.
optionsPlaceholder.description: Placeholder text on the options page until Phase 4 builds the configuration UI.

resultScopeAllInputs.description: Names the fill scope inside resultSettled and resultCapped (UC-001).

resultScopeCurrentForm.description: Names the fill scope inside resultSettled and resultCapped (UC-002).

resultScopeSelectedInput.description: Names the fill scope inside resultSettled and resultCapped (UC-003).

resultSettled.description: Toolbar tooltip after a fill that settled (DD-006).

resultCapped.message: $COUNT$ filled in $SCOPE$ — $STALE$ may be stale, because $REASON$
resultCapped.description: Toolbar tooltip after a fill that stopped at a bound rather than settling (FR-078, DD-006).

resultCapUserInput.description: Why a fill stopped: the user interacted with the page (FR-079).

resultCapPassCap.description: Why a fill stopped: the pass cap was reached (UC-034).

resultCapTimeBudget.message: the page took too long to settle
resultCapTimeBudget.description: Why a fill stopped: the cascade time budget was reached (NFR-034).

resultCapValuesUnavailable.message: the extension could not be reached
resultCapValuesUnavailable.description: Why a fill stopped: the background did not answer a descriptor batch.

resultRulesSkipped.description: Appended when a configured rule could not run (DD-005).

reportHeading.description: Heading of the fill report on the options page (DD-006).

reportNone.message: No report is available. The extension's background process is stopped between uses, and the last fill's report goes with it — fill a page and come straight back to see one.
reportNone.description: Shown when no report is held, which is an ordinary outcome rather than an error (DD-006, NFR-020).

reportColumnField.description: Report table column: how the field is named on the page.

reportColumnOutcome.description: Report table column: filled, skipped or failed.

reportColumnDetail.description: Report table column: provenance for a filled field, the reason otherwise (FR-069).

reportStatusFilled.description: A control that was written and verified (FR-076).

reportStatusFailed.description: A control that could not be filled (FR-010).

reportPrivacyNote.message: This report is held in memory only, covers one fill, and is never written to storage. No value from the page is recorded — only how each field was named and why it received what it did.
reportPrivacyNote.description: States the retention bound the report operates under (NFR-010, NFR-030).

resultExcluded.message: Filling is off here — $PATTERN$ is on your excluded list
resultExcluded.description: Toolbar tooltip on a domain the user excluded (FR-038, UC-008). Names the pattern so it can be found and changed.

resultExcludedUnreadable.message: Filling is off here — this page's address could not be read, so the excluded list could not be checked
resultExcludedUnreadable.description: Toolbar tooltip for UC-008 A1: the URL was unreadable, so the fill was refused. Distinct from resultExcluded, which names a pattern the user actually listed.

resultRefusedNoForm.message: No form found around what you pointed at, so nothing was filled
resultRefusedNoForm.description: Shown when the DD-008 ladder cannot resolve a form root from an anchor (UC-002 A3).

resultRefusedNoAnchor.description: Shown when a narrow scope was invoked with no anchor at all (UC-003 A2).

reportScopeChosenBy.description: Options-page report line naming which rung of the DD-008 ladder resolved the scope (BR-002-4).

rule.example: the form the page says the field belongs to

resultRuleElementForm.message: the form the page says the field belongs to
resultRuleElementForm.description: DD-008 ladder rule 1 (element-form), named for a user.

resultRuleRoleForm.message: a container the page marks as a form
resultRuleRoleForm.description: DD-008 ladder rule 2 (role-form), named for a user.

resultRuleSubmitContainer.message: the smallest block holding that field and its submit button
resultRuleSubmitContainer.description: DD-008 ladder rule 3 (submit-container), named for a user.

resultRuleOnlyUnit.message: the only form on the page
resultRuleOnlyUnit.description: DD-008's anchorless case with exactly one form-like unit (UC-002 A2).

resultRuleWholePage.description: DD-008's anchorless case with no single form-like unit (UC-002 A2).

resultRuleAnchorControl.description: The single-control scope, which resolves to the anchor itself (UC-003).

rulesHeading.description: Heading of the rule list on the options page (UC-009).

rulesIntro.message: Rules decide what a matching field receives. The first rule that matches a field wins, so order matters — move a rule up to give it precedence. Fields no rule matches are filled from the built-in generators.
rulesIntro.description: Explains the rule list, including that order is precedence (FR-031).

rulesEmpty.message: No rules yet. Without any, every field is filled from the built-in generators — which is a complete configuration, not an empty one.
rulesEmpty.description: Shown when the rule list is empty (UC-009).

ruleAdd.description: Button that appends a new rule (UC-009).

ruleUnnamed.description: Stands in for a rule whose name is blank (BR-009-3).

ruleLabel.description: Field label for a rule's name, shown in the fill report as provenance.

ruleLabelHint.message: Shown in the fill report, so you can tell which rule produced a value.
ruleLabelHint.description: Help text under the rule name field (FR-069).

ruleEnabled.description: Toggle that keeps a rule but stops it being applied (UC-010 A3).

ruleMatch.description: Label for the rule's pattern field.

ruleMatchMode.description: Label for the matcher's mode select (FR-068).

ruleModeContains.description: Match mode: the field's identity contains this text.

ruleModeExact.description: Match mode: the field's identity is exactly this text.

ruleModeRegex.description: Match mode: the pattern is a regular expression.

ruleMatchHint.message: Matching ignores case. Your pattern is used exactly as written — nothing is added to it.
ruleMatchHint.description: States that patterns are never rewritten (FR-068).

ruleSources.description: Label for the per-rule source scoping (FR-067).

ruleSourcesAll.description: Default option for a rule that names no sources (FR-067).

sourceName.description: Identity source: the control's name attribute (FR-027).

sourceId.description: Identity source: the control's id attribute (FR-027).

sourceClassName.description: Identity source: the control's class attribute. Off globally by default, being the noisiest (FR-028).

sourceLabel.description: Identity source: the text of the control's label (FR-027).

sourcePlaceholder.description: Identity source: the control's placeholder attribute (FR-027).

ruleGenerator.description: Label for the generator type select (FR-019).

ruleFromPersona.description: Toggle for the coherence flag (ND-1, DD-005).

ruleFromPersonaHint.message: On, the value belongs to the same person as the rest of the form — so a confirmation field or a summary still agrees. Off, it is unrelated to the other fields.
ruleFromPersonaHint.description: Explains the coherence flag in the user's terms rather than the design's.

ruleMoveUp.description: Reorders a rule one place earlier (UC-012).

ruleMoveDown.description: Reorders a rule one place later (UC-012).

ruleDeleted.description: Announces a deletion, beside the undo offer (UC-011).

ruleUndo.description: Restores a just-deleted rule to its old position (UC-011 A1).

ruleMoved.description: Announced after a move, so the change is perceivable without sight of the list (BR-012-2).

settingsSaveFailed.message: That change could not be saved, so it is not in effect: $REASON$. Your other settings are unchanged.
settingsSaveFailed.description: UC-024 A2/A3: a write that was rejected has to say so, and why. The page is optimistic in memory, so without this the editor shows a change that storage does not have — and a reload silently undoes it.

reason.example: the browser storage quota is full

settingsChangedElsewhere.message: Your settings were changed somewhere else. The rule you are editing is safe and your next change will not overwrite theirs; the rest of the list is out of date on screen and refreshes when you close this rule.
settingsChangedElsewhere.description: UC-024: another options page wrote settings while a rule was open here. Memory adopts their state with the draft carried across, so the next write cannot revert them; only the rendered list is left stale, because replacing it would take the caret out of the open editor.

listChangedElsewhere.message: This list was changed somewhere else, so it has been redrawn here. Your last change to it was not applied — the entry it was aimed at had already moved.
listChangedElsewhere.description: UC-024, BR-024-3: exclusion rows and a profile's address patterns are addressed by position in lists that carry no identifiers, and this page skips re-rendering a section the user is working in. A row whose entry has moved refuses to write and redraws instead, because editing or deleting the wrong entry is worse than losing a keystroke.

settingsAdoptedFromElsewhere.message: Your settings were changed somewhere else, and this page has been updated to match.
settingsAdoptedFromElsewhere.description: UC-024, BR-024-3: another writer changed settings while nothing was being edited here, so the page adopted them rather than going on to overwrite them.

rulePreviewEmpty.message: Fill in the rule to see what it produces.
rulePreviewEmpty.description: Shown before a rule is complete enough to preview.

rulePreviewUnusable.message: This rule is valid but produced no value. An imported pattern may use syntax this generator does not support.
rulePreviewUnusable.description: Shown when a valid rule cannot generate (UC-013 A2).

ruleInvalid.description: Frames one validation failure beside the field that caused it (FR-070, UC-009 A1). The substitution is a whole sentence resolved from a ruleProblem* key, never prose assembled in code — see RuleProblemCode in src/lib/rules/validate.ts.

problem.example: the match pattern is empty. Type the text a field's name should contain.

ruleProblemPatternEmpty.message: the match pattern is empty. Type the text a field's name should contain.
ruleProblemPatternEmpty.description: FR-070. Every ruleProblem* message names the cause and the correction in one sentence (NFR-020), and is written to read after "Not saved: ".

ruleProblemPatternInvalid.message: that is not a valid regular expression ($DETAIL$). Correct the syntax, or switch the mode to Contains to match the text literally.
ruleProblemPatternInvalid.description: FR-070. The detail is the regex engine's own complaint, which is not translated.

ruleProblemPatternBacktracks.message: this pattern can backtrack catastrophically and would hang the extension — $DETAIL$. Rewrite the repeated group so its parts cannot match the same text.
ruleProblemPatternBacktracks.description: FR-070, NFR-009. The detail names the offending construct and is not translated.

detail.example: "(a+)+" repeats a group that already repeats — the classic (a+)+ shape

ruleProblemNoSources.message: this rule matches against no source, so it can never fire. Tick at least one source, or go back to "Whatever is enabled globally".
ruleProblemNoSources.description: FR-067. Unticking all six is one click away in the editor and produces a rule that looks finished and is dead.

ruleProblemTemplateInvalid.message: the template cannot be read — $DETAIL$. Fix the placeholder, or remove the braces to use the text literally.
ruleProblemTemplateInvalid.description: FR-070. The detail names the offending placeholder and is not translated.

detail.example: "{nope}" is not a placeholder. Available: letter, digit, alphanumeric

ruleProblemRegexUngeneratable.message: no value can be generated from this pattern — $DETAIL$. Generation supports literals, character classes, groups, alternation and quantifiers; replace anything else.
ruleProblemRegexUngeneratable.description: FR-021, FR-070. A pattern can be valid to match with and impossible to generate from.

ruleProblemGeneratorBacktracks.message: this pattern can backtrack catastrophically — $DETAIL$. Rewrite the repeated group so its parts cannot match the same text.
ruleProblemGeneratorBacktracks.description: FR-070, NFR-009, for the generator's own pattern rather than the matcher's.

detail.example: "(a|ab)+" repeats alternatives that can both match "a", so a failure has to try every split

ruleProblemListEmpty.message: a randomised list needs at least one item. Type one value per line.

ruleProblemNumberRange.message: the minimum is greater than the maximum. Lower the minimum, or raise the maximum.

ruleProblemTextRange.message: the shortest length is greater than the longest. Lower the shortest, or raise the longest.

ruleProblemDateNoToken.message: the format contains no date token, so every field would receive the format itself. Use tokens such as YYYY-MM-DD.

ruleProblemDateBounds.message: the range bounds must be real dates, written as YYYY-MM-DD.

ruleProblemDateRange.message: the date range starts after it ends. Swap the two bounds.

genNamePart.description: Selects full, first or last name.

genAlphanumeric.description: Generator type: the braced placeholder grammar (FR-020).

genRegex.description: Generator type: values generated from a pattern (FR-021).

genFormatHint.message: YYYY, YY, MMM, MM, DD, HH, mm and ss are replaced. Everything else is kept as written.
genFormatHint.description: Documents the date tokens (our own grammar, not moment's).

genFrom.description: Date generator: the start of the range.

genTo.description: Date generator: the end of the range.

genTemplate.description: Alphanumeric generator: the pattern to expand.

genTemplateHint.message: Placeholders are braced and named: {digit:4}, {upper:2}, {letter}, {consonant}, {vowel}, {alnum}, {symbol}. Anything outside braces is kept as written.

genPattern.description: Regex generator: the expression to generate from.

genPatternHint.message: Supports literals, character classes, groups, alternation and quantifiers. Lookahead and backreferences cannot be generated from and are refused.

genItems.description: List generator: the values to choose between.

genItemsHint.message: One per line. A field gets one of them, chosen independently each time.

genValue.description: Constant generator: the value to write.

generalHeading.description: Options page section heading: settings that are not specific to one screen.

localeLabel.description: Label for the corpus locale control (ND-1). "Locale" as in which country's names, addresses and phone numbers a fill draws from.

localeAuto.description: The default locale option: resolve against the browser's own UI language.

localeHint.message: Which country's names, addresses and phone numbers a fill draws from. Following the browser is right for most people; choose a locale explicitly if you test forms for a market your browser is not set to.

localeChanged.description: Announced politely after the locale changes.

sourcesHeading.description: Options page section heading for UC-018.

sourcesIntro.message: Which parts of a field's markup rules are allowed to match against. A source switched off here is off for every rule, including rules that name it.
sourcesIntro.description: Intro paragraph for the matching sources section (FR-028). States that the setting is a bound, not a default.

sourcesLegend.description: Fieldset legend grouping the six source checkboxes.

sourcesEnabledCount.description: Count shown beneath the source checkboxes.

sourcesNoneEnabled.message: No sources are enabled, so no rule can match anything. Fields are still filled by the built-in generator.
sourcesNoneEnabled.description: Shown instead of the count when every source is off. Says what still works, so the state reads as configured rather than broken.

sourceEnabled.description: Announced politely when a matching source is switched on.

sourceDisabled.description: Announced politely when a matching source is switched off.

fieldExclusionsHeading.description: Options page section heading for UC-020.

fieldExclusionsIntro.message: Controls matching any of these are left exactly as they are. CAPTCHAs, coupon codes and anything else a generated value would spoil.
fieldExclusionsIntro.description: Intro paragraph for the field exclusions section (FR-036).

exclusionsEmpty.message: No field exclusions. Every fillable control is a candidate.
exclusionsEmpty.description: Empty state for the field exclusion list. An empty list is a working configuration, not a missing one.

exclusionAdd.description: Button that appends a blank field exclusion.

exclusionPattern.description: Label for a field exclusion's pattern box.

exclusionPatternHint.message: Matched against the same sources rules use, case-insensitively.
exclusionPatternHint.description: Hint under a field exclusion's pattern box.

exclusionRemove.description: Button that deletes one exclusion from a list.

exclusionUnnamed.description: Stands in for an exclusion's pattern in a button's accessible name while the pattern is still empty.

exclusionRemoved.description: Announced politely after a field exclusion is deleted.

domainExclusionsHeading.description: Options page section heading for UC-021.

domainExclusionsIntro.message: On these sites the extension does nothing at all — every way of asking for a fill is refused, and the toolbar badge says so. Production and banking sites belong here.
domainExclusionsIntro.description: Intro paragraph for the domain exclusions section (FR-037, FR-074, BR-008-4).

domainsEmpty.message: No sites excluded. Fills are available everywhere.
domainsEmpty.description: Empty state for the domain exclusion list.

domainAdd.description: Button that appends a blank domain exclusion.

domainPattern.description: Label for a domain exclusion's pattern box.

domainPatternHint.message: * stands for any run of characters; everything else is literal. The port is ignored. For example: *.example.com/* or localhost/*
domainPatternHint.description: Hint under a domain exclusion's pattern box. Names the vocabulary rather than calling it a regular expression, which it is not.

domainRemoved.description: Announced politely after a domain exclusion is deleted.

domainProblemEmpty.message: Not in force: this pattern is empty.
domainProblemEmpty.description: Validation message for a blank domain pattern (UC-021).

domainProblemWhitespace.message: Not in force: an address contains no spaces, so this pattern matches nothing.
domainProblemWhitespace.description: Validation message for a domain pattern containing whitespace. Says it matches nothing, because an exclusion that matches nothing fails open.

behaviourHeading.description: Options page section heading for UC-022.

behaviourIntro.message: What a fill does to the controls it decides to fill.
behaviourIntro.description: Intro paragraph for the behaviour section.

behaviourDispatchEvents.message: Tell the page about each value
behaviourDispatchEvents.description: Label for the event dispatch toggle (FR-014). Says what it does rather than naming the DOM events.

behaviourDispatchEventsHint.message: Sends the same input and change events a person typing would. Turn this off only for pages whose handlers misbehave — React, Vue and Angular forms need it to notice the value at all.
behaviourDispatchEventsHint.description: Hint under the event dispatch toggle. Names the cost of turning it off.

behaviourSkipHidden.message: Skip controls that are not visible

behaviourSkipHiddenHint.message: On by default. Filling an invisible field is how a honeypot catches a bot, and the field is invisible precisely so that a person would not fill it.

behaviourSkipPreFilled.message: Skip controls that already hold a value

behaviourSkipPreFilledHint.message: Off by default, so filling the same form twice gives fresh data each time. Our own earlier writes never count as content either way.
behaviourSkipPreFilledHint.description: Hint under the pre-filled toggle (FR-075, BR-005-7).

behaviourLengthsLegend.description: Fieldset legend for the per-kind length caps (FR-065).

behaviourLengthHint.message: Leave empty for no limit. A control declaring its own maxlength is bound by that instead.
behaviourLengthHint.description: Hint under each length cap box. States that the page wins (ND-11).

behaviourConsentKeywords.description: Label for the consent keyword list (FR-015).

behaviourConsentKeywordsHint.message: One per line. A checkbox whose markup contains any of these is always ticked, so a terms gate never blocks a test submission. Required checkboxes are ticked regardless.
behaviourConsentKeywordsHint.description: Hint under the consent keyword list. Names the rule that is not configurable.

behaviourConfirmationKeywords.description: Label for the confirmation keyword list (FR-024).

behaviourConfirmationKeywordsHint.message: One per line. A field whose markup contains any of these repeats the value of the field it confirms. A trailing 2 — password2 beside password — also counts, and is built in.
behaviourConfirmationKeywordsHint.description: Hint under the confirmation keyword list. States the part that is not configurable (UC-022).

kindText.description: Control kind name, for the length limit boxes.

kindSearch.description: Control kind name, for the length limit boxes.

kindTextarea.description: Control kind name, for the length limit boxes.

kindContenteditable.description: Control kind name for a contenteditable element, for the length limit boxes.

passwordsHeading.description: Options page section heading for UC-019.

passwordsIntro.message: The policy a generated password starts from. A field's own pattern, minlength and maxlength are applied on top, and the field always wins.
passwordsIntro.description: Intro paragraph for the password section (FR-025, FR-072).

passwordLength.description: Label for the password length box.

passwordLengthHint.message: How long a generated password is before the field's own limits are applied.
passwordLengthHint.description: Hint under the password length box.

passwordClassesLegend.description: Fieldset legend for the four character-class checkboxes.

passwordNoClasses.message: With nothing ticked there is nothing to build a password from, so lowercase letters are used.
passwordNoClasses.description: Shown above the sample when every character class is off (UC-019 A1). States the fallback rather than leaving it to be inferred.

triggersHeading.description: Options page section heading for UC-023.

triggersIntro.message: Three ways to ask for a fill. Which one you use changes only which scopes it can offer, never what a fill does.
triggersIntro.description: Intro paragraph for the triggers section (BR-001-6, BR-023-3).

triggerToolbarAlways.message: The toolbar button always fills the whole page. It has no setting: it is the one route that needs no setup.
triggerToolbarAlways.description: Statement that the toolbar trigger carries no control (BR-023-2).

triggerContextMenu.description: Label for the context menu toggle (FR-050).

triggerContextMenuHint.message: The only way to fill just one form or just one field, because it is the only one that knows where you were pointing.
triggerContextMenuHint.description: Hint under the context menu toggle (BR-001-6). Says what turning it off costs.

triggerContextMenuOn.description: Announced politely when the context menu is switched on.

triggerContextMenuOff.description: Announced politely when the context menu is switched off.

triggerShortcutsRoute.message: Keyboard shortcuts are assigned by the browser, not here. Open $ADDRESS$ to see or change them.
triggerShortcutsRoute.description: Route to the browser's own shortcut settings (BR-023-1). Worded as an address to visit rather than a control that rebinds anything.

reportProfileApplied.description: Options-page report line naming the profile that governed the fill (FR-047, UC-017).

reportProfileNone.message: No profile matched this page, so your global rules ran on their own.
reportProfileNone.description: Options-page report line when no profile applied. Stated rather than left silent: a tester checking whether their scoped rules were in effect cannot read that from an absent line (FR-047).

profilesHeading.description: Options page section heading for UC-014..UC-016.

profilesIntro.message: A named set of rules that applies only to the pages you scope it to. Its rules are tried before your global ones; the first profile whose address pattern matches the page is the one that governs it.
profilesIntro.description: Intro paragraph for the profiles section. States both precedence rules (FR-031, BR-014-2) because neither is guessable from the list.

profilesEmpty.message: No profiles. Your global rules run on every page.
profilesEmpty.description: Empty state for the profile list. An empty list is a working configuration.

profileAdd.description: Button that appends a blank profile.

profileLabel.description: Label for a profile's name box.

profileLabelHint.message: Shown in the fill report, so you can tell which profile ran.
profileLabelHint.description: Hint under a profile's name box (FR-047).

profileEnabled.description: Checkbox turning a profile off without deleting it.

profileUrls.description: Fieldset legend for a profile's URL patterns.

profileUrlPattern.description: Label for one of a profile's URL pattern boxes.

profileAddUrl.description: Button that appends a blank URL pattern to a profile.

profileNoUrls.message: This profile matches no page, because it has no address patterns. Add one to make it apply.
profileNoUrls.description: Shown when a profile has no URL patterns (UC-014 A2). A profile with none matches nothing rather than everything, which is inert and would otherwise be invisible.

profileRulesHeading.description: Heading above a profile's own rule list.

profileRulesHint.message: Tried before your global rules on a page this profile matches. Everything else about a rule works exactly as it does below.
profileRulesHint.description: Hint above a profile's rule editor, distinguishing it from the global list on the same page (FR-031).

profileUnnamed.description: Stands in for a profile's name in a button's accessible name while it is still blank.

profileDelete.description: Button that deletes a whole profile.

profileDeleteConfirm.message: Delete the profile "$PROFILE$" and the $COUNT$ rules in it? This cannot be undone.
profileDeleteConfirm.description: Confirmation before deleting a profile that contains rules (UC-016). The count is in the question because deleting a profile with rules is a different act from deleting an empty one.

profileDeleteConfirmEmpty.description: Confirmation before deleting a profile with no rules in it.

profileDeleted.description: Announced politely after a profile is deleted.

profileRemovedElsewhere.message: The profile you were editing was deleted somewhere else, so its editor has closed. Anything you were writing inside it is gone with it.
profileRemovedElsewhere.description: UC-015 A4: another options page deleted the profile open here. The editor is closed rather than left over a profile that no longer exists, and the rule draft inside it is dropped — said plainly, because the editor disappearing on its own would otherwise look like a fault.

profileMoved.description: Announced politely after a profile is reordered (BR-014-2).
